body.message: Dear all, This is Rayan Laundry & Dry-Cleaning Services, Located in Business Bay, Downtown, Dubai.   Rayan Laundry is highly regarded in Dubai for its expertise in handling high-end branded clothing and specialized luxury fabric care. According to customer reviews and industry features across various platforms, we are known for several key factors:German Eco-Cleaning Tech: we use advanced, imported German detergents and non-toxic, eco-friendly chemicals that safely target stubborn stains without damaging delicate clothing fibers.Designer & Luxury Brand Care: we specialize in treating expensive luxury brands, silks, wedding dresses, and delicate garments to restore them to a like-new condition.Luxury Handbag & Shoe Restoration: we have a dedicated "sneaker spa" and leather restoration unit specifically designed for deep-cleaning, conditioning, and restoring high-end items such as Prada leather bags.Home Textile Care: Beyond clothing, we are known for deep-cleaning heavily soiled carpets and curtains.Hospitals & Clinics Linens & Uniforms: we provide specialized, healthcare-grade medical laundry and sanitization services for hospitals & medical/dental clinics across Dubai. we strictly separate commercial healthcare processing from standard residential garments to prevent cross-contamination.Premium Quality at Affordable Rates: we are widely recognized for offering five-star, meticulous cleaning quality at a highly competitive & affordable price point compare to other luxury laundry chains in the city.  we help luxury brands, premium spas, premium gyms, luxury beauty salons, holiday homes, hospitals & clinics in Dubai maintain perfect presentation standards with our 100% in-house commercial laundry services. What we offer:Reliable pickup & delivery across Dubai.High quality & premium care.A dedicated account manager for smooth daily communication & operational support.Customized quotation based on your quantities.Flexible payment options & plans. We handle thousands of garments weekly with strict quality care & we would be thrilled to handle yours. Kindly find the attached file for our company profile & don’t hesitate to send us any questions for more information regarding our services.  Looking forward to hearing from you.  Regards,,,  Ahmed Gad Ceo, Founder, Al Rayan Laundry – Dry Cleaning & Laundry Services.+971585768004info@rayanlaundry.comHead Office: Damac Executive Bay – Tower B – G 14,Ala’amal St – Business Bay – Dubai – UAE.
